description: This file contains unit tests for the IPC Controller component in the Rialto server manager, utilizing Google Test framework. It defines a test fixture class 'IpcTests' with methods to simulate IPC events, configure responses, and verify interactions with mocked session server app manager.

classes.name: IpcTests
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing the IPC Controller in Rialto, providing methods to simulate IPC events, configure responses, and verify interactions with mocks.

methods.description: Constructor initializing mock objects and the system under test (SUT).
